 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (basisofrecord <> 'LIVING_SPECIMEN' AND (establishmentmeans.concept IS NULL OR establishmentmeans.concept NOT IN ('introduced','introducedAssistedColonisation','vagrant')) AND (degreeofestablishment.concept IS NULL OR degreeofestablishment.concept NOT IN ('managed','cultivated','captive','released','failing','casual','unestablished','reproducing','established','colonising','spreading','naturalized','invasive','widespreadInvasive')) AND NOT COALESCE(ARRAY_CONTAINS(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_FUZZY'),FALSE) AND (v_kingdom IS NULL OR kingdom IS NULL OR LOWER(v_kingdom) NOT IN ('animalia','plantae','fungi') OR LOWER(kingdom) NOT IN ('animalia','plantae','fungi') OR LOWER(v_kingdom) = LOWER(kingdom)) AND (taxonomicstatus IS NULL OR LOWER(taxonomicstatus) NOT IN ('ambiguous_synonym','misapplied'))) AND license IN ('CC0_1_0','CC_BY_4_0') THEN COALESCE("year",0) END, COALESCE("month",0), COALESCE("day",0), GBIF_ISEA3HCode(17, decimallatitude, decimallongitude, 0)) AS n_visits_open
FROM occurrence
WHERE hascoordinate = TRUE AND hasgeospatialissues = FALSE AND occurrencestatus = 'DETECTED' AND specieskey IS NOT NULL
 AND basisofrecord <> 'FOSSIL_SPECIMEN' AND (coordinateuncertaintyinmeters IS NULL OR coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 100000)
GROUP BY specieskey, countrycode, GBIF_ISEA3HCode(7, decimallatitude, decimallongitude, 0), CASE WHEN level0gid IS NULL THEN 'sea' ELSE 'land' END
